messages:
Maya: Quick sync 1 — I dropped a one-pager + webinar storyboard in Drive (security, SLAs, deploy-mode guidance). Can reviewers get eyes by EOD Wed? :pray:
Arjun: Who
re we targeting first? Platform/SRE or security/compliance? Need that for headline A/B.
Maya: Primary: Platform/SRE and SecOps. Secondary: Product/Infra teams evaluating cost vs latency.
Priya: Layout looks tight. Suggest smaller hero + two benchmark callouts (latency vs cost) and icons for Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
Hannah: Small data note: internal bench sheet -> https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/enterprise-launch-bench. p50: hosted=120ms, dedicated=85ms, private on-prem=150ms median.
Leo: Copy should highlight SLA tiers: "SLA-backed latency tiers for enterprise inference" and a bullet on automated failover/routing.
Sofia: Routing rule proposal: gate webinar CTA by company size + industry. Route >$250k ARR to AE, finance/healthcare to AE-compliance, others to SDR.
Maya: Draft rule in doc:
if lead.commit >= 250000 -> AE-enterprise
elif lead.industry in ['finance','healthcare'] -> AE-compliance
else -> SDR-nurture
Arjun: We'll A/B test two headlines: security-first vs cost+performance. Priya to produce two hero variants.
Hannah: I'll instrument variant tracking and a Looker dashboard for lead conversion (48h ETA).
Sofia: Webinar plan: 45m total: 20m product, 15m benchmarks, 10m customer story. Follow-ups: Day0 recording+playbook, Day3 case study, Day10 AE outreach.
Maya: Benchmarking guidance: no micro-claims. Frame as "real-world throughput & cost improvements using batching, caching, and smart routing". Link to methodology appendix.
Arjun: Add an ops note on graceful degradation: fallback to cheaper model variants when Dedicated is saturated. Helps resilience sell.
DevBot: Uploaded asset: /drive/marketing/enterprise/onepager-1755012345-v1.pdf :white_check_mark:
Priya: Will add a short FAQ accordion on compliance and deployment modes in the one-pager appendix.
Leo: Please add a 3-bullet methodology slide for the webinar: 1) production-like workloads, 2) end-to-end p50/p95/p99 latency, 3) cost per 1k tokens with batching toggles.
Maya: Action items: Arjun finalize headlines by tomorrow 12pm; Priya design variants EOD; Hannah dashboard 48h; Sofia finalize routing + emails EOD Wed. Lock one-pager by EOD Thu. Next check-in 10:30am PT tomorrow. :calendar:
